questions.question: Original breadth of a rectangular box is 20 cm. The box was then remade in such a way that its length increased by 30% but the breadth decreased by 20% and the area increased by 100 cm². What is the new area of the box?
questions.solution:
**Given****∶**

Original breadth of the rectangular box = b = 20 cm

Percentage increase in length = 30%

Percentage decrease in breadth = 20%

**Calculation****∶**

Let original length of the rectangular box be l.

⇒ Original area of rectangular box = lb = 20l

⇒ Length of the rectangular box after 30% increase = 130/100 × l

⇒ Breadth of the rectangular box after 20% decrease = 80% of b = 80/100 × 20 = 16 cm

⇒ New Area of the rectangular box = 130/100 × l × 16

According to the question,

New Area of the rectangular box = Original area of rectangular box + 100

⇒ 130/100 × l × 16 = 20l + 100

⇒ l(20.8 – 20) = 100

⇒ 0.8l = 100

⇒ l = 1000/8 = 125 cm

∴ New Area of the rectangular box = 130/100 × l × 16 = 130/100 × 125 × 16 = 130 × 20 = 2600 cm²

questions.solution:
a + b – c = 7, ab – bc – ca = 21

**Calculation****∶**

**Formula****∶** (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca

Put c = – c into above identity,

⇒ (a + b – c)² = a² + b² + ( – c)² + 2ab + 2b( – c) + 2( – c)a

⇒ (a + b – c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2ab – 2bc – 2ca ----(1)

**Formula****∶** a³ + b³ + c³ – 3abc = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² – ab – bc – ca)

Put c = – c into above identity,

⇒ a³ + b³ + ( – c)³ – 3ab( – c) = {a + b + ( – c)}{a² + b² + ( – c)² – ab – b( – c) – ( – c)a}

⇒ a³ + b³ – c³ + 3abc = (a + b – c)(a² + b² + c² – ab + bc + ca)

⇒ a³ + b³ – c³ + 3abc = (a + b – c)(a² + b² + c² – ab + bc + ca + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca – 2ab – 2bc – 2ca)

⇒ a³ + b³ – c³ + 3abc = (a + b – c)(a² + b² + c² + 2ab – 2bc – 2ca – 3ab + 3bc + 3ca)

Using equation (1),

⇒ a³ + b³ – c³ + 3abc = (a + b – c){(a + b – c)² – 3ab + 3bc + 3ca}

⇒ a³ + b³ – c³ + 3abc = (a + b – c){(a + b – c)² – 3(ab – bc – ca)} ----(2)

Put the value of a + b – c = 7, ab – bc – ca = 21 into equation (2)

⇒ a³ + b³ – c³ + 3abc = 7 (7² – 3 × 21)

⇒ a³ + b³ – c³ + 3abc = 7 (49 – 63) = 7 × ( – 14) = – 98

questions.question: boy increases his speed to (9)/(5) times of his original speed. By this he reaches his school 30 minutes before the usual time. How much time does he takes usually?
questions.solution:
Let the speed of the boy be V and time taken by the boy to reach his school be T.

Speed of the boy after increase = 9/5 V

Time taken by the boy to reach his school after increase in speed = T – 30

Since distance is same for both cases.

∴ Distance = VT = 9/5 V (T – 30)

9/5 T – T = 54

T = 54 × 5/4 = 67.5 minutes

questions.question: When the integer n is divided by 7, the remainder is 3. What is the remainder if 5n is divided by 7?
questions.solution:
When the integer n is divided by 7, the remainder is 3. Therefore, to find the remainder when 5n is divided by 7, we have to multiply 3 by 5 and then divide it by 7.

⇒ 3 × 5 = 15

When 15 is divided by 7, remainder is 1.

∴ When 5n is divided by 7, remainder is 1.

questions.question: 3 men, 4 women and 6 children can complete a work in 7 days. A woman does double the work a man does and a child does half the work a man does. How many women alone can complete this work in 7 days?

questions.question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 16 minutes and pipe B empties it in 24 minutes. If both the pipes are opened together, after how many minutes should B be closed, so that the tank is filled in 30 minutes?
questions.solution:
**Given****∶**

Time taken by pipe A to fill the tank = 16 minutes

Time taken by pipe B to empty the tank = 24 minutes

**Calculation****∶**

Efficiency of pipe A = 1/16

Efficiency of pipe B = 1/24

Filling of tank by pipe A in 30 minutes = 30 × 1/16 = 15/8

Amount of water filled by pipe A which is in excess after filling the tank = 15/8 – 1 = 7/8

This excess water is emptied by pipe B when they open together.

Time taken by pipe B to empty excess water = (7/8) / (1/24) = 21 minutes

**Alternate Solution****∶**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c84c31a3cef01f5842e536dba124f80d6f976a0100851bd1579d9213e81f4f1b.png] **

Excess water filled by pipe A = 90 – 48 = 42

This excess water is emptied by pipe B when they open together.

Time taken by pipe B to empty excess water = 42/2 = 21 minutes

questions.question: Rs. 15,000 was invested by A and B together to start a small business. They got a profit of Rs. 2,000 at the end of the year. B took his profit share of Rs. 600. How much did A invest?
questions.solution:
**Given****∶**

Total investment of A and B together = Rs. 15000

Total profit of A and B together at the end of year = Rs. 2000

Profit of B = Rs. 600

**Calculation****∶**

Profit of A = 2000 – 600 = Rs. 1400

Ratio of profit of A and B = 1400 ∶ 600 = 7 ∶ 3

We know that ratio of profit is equal to the ratio of investment. Here time investment is same for both therefore ratio of profit is equal to the ratio of money investment.

∴ Ratio of money investment = 7 ∶ 3

Total ratio = 7 + 3 = 10

⇒ Money invested by A = 7/10 × 15000 = Rs. 10500

⇒ ( – 4)² – 4 × 1 × a = 0

⇒ a = 16/4 = 4

questions.question: A man could not decide between discount of 30% or two successive discounts of 25% and 5%, both given on a shopping of Rs. 2,000. What is the difference between both the discounts?
questions.solution:
**Short Trick****∶**

**Formula****∶** Equivalent discount of the two successive discounts a% and b% = {a + b – (a × b/100)}%

Equivalent discount of the two successive discounts 25% and 5% = 25 + 5 – (25 × 5/100) = 30 – 1.25 = 28.75%

Single Discount = 30%

Difference in both discount = (30 – 28.75)% of 2000 = 1.25/100 × 2000 = Rs. 25

**Detailed Solution****∶**

Shopping amount = Rs. 2000

1st Condition∶

Discount percentage = 30%

Discount = 30% of 2000 = 30/100 × 2000 = Rs. 600

2ⁿd Condition∶

First discount percentage = 25%

First discount = 25% of 2000 = 25/100 × 2000 = Rs. 500

Shopping amount after first discount = 2000 – 500 = Rs. 1500

Second discount percentage = 5%

Second discount = 5/100 × 1500 = Rs. 75

Total discount = 500 + 75 = Rs. 575

∴ Difference in both condition = 600 – 575 = Rs. 25

questions.question: A number is first decreased by 10% and then increased by 10%. The number so obtained is 100 less than the original number. The original number is∶

Let the number be N.

Number after 10% decrease = 90% of N

Number after 10% increase = 110% of 90% of N = 110/100 × 90/100 × N = 99/100 × N

A can do a work in 20 days, while B can do the same work in 25 days. They started the work jointly. Few days later C also joined them and thus all of them completed the whole work in 10 days. All of them were paid total of Rs. 700. What is the share of C?
questions.solution:
**Given****∶**

Time taken by A to complete the whole work = 20 days

Time taken by B to complete the whole work = 25 days

Time taken by A, B and C to complete the whole work when C join them few days later after their starting = 10 days

Total amount paid to A, B and C = Rs. 700

**Calculation****∶**

Efficiency of A = EA = 1/20

Efficiency of B = EB = 1/25

⇒ Efficiency of A and B together = 1/20 + 1/25 = 9/100

⇒ Work done by A and B together in 10 days = 9/100 × 10 = 9/10

⇒ Remaining work = 1 – 9/10 = 1/10

This 1/10 work is done by C in 10 days.

Let the efficiency of C be EC.

We know that,

Work done = efficiency × number of days

⇒ 1/10 = EC × 10

⇒ EC = 1/100

Share of A, B and C in total amount paid to them will be in the ratio of their efficiency.

∴ EA ∶ EB ∶ EC = 1/20 ∶ 1/25 ∶ 1/100 = 5 ∶ 4 ∶ 1

Share of C = 1/(5 + 4 + 1) × 700 = 1/10 × 700 = Rs. 70

**Alternate Solution****∶**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29d7fb3f43313837ecfdac6525446c95dba8e54c96ab891c5209803d61ea24d2.png] **

Efficiency of A = 5

Efficiency of B = 4

work done by A and B together in 10 days = (5 + 4) × 10 = 90

Remaining work = 100 – 90 = 10

This remaining work is done by C in 10 days.

∴ Total work is done by C in 100 days.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/959413523d7492350aa47708929cb348cf6623ca6df89b22e2d88a2d8fc61ba2.png] 

Efficiency of C = 1

Ratio of efficiency of A, B and C = 5 ∶ 4 ∶ 1

Share of C = 1/(5 + 4 + 1) × 700 = Rs. 70
